attachment_rules: Attach copies of information slips to a paper return.

unresolved_gaps: Annual CRA forms and web pages can change after the access date; production needs controlled source refresh and approval.
The T2209 line-transfer conflict remains unresolved in official sources.
Mailing and payment destinations need live official confirmation at generation time.
This inventory does not define PDF field coordinates, a tax engine, or a validation schema.
Elections, designations, carrybacks, reserves, loss limitations, and factual classifications need separate supported workflows and qualified review.
Trust, estate, bankruptcy, emigrant, non-resident, deemed-resident, tax-shelter, and multi-jurisdiction cases cannot be forced through the ordinary Ontario resident flow.
GST/HST return preparation and filing are outside the T1 mail-in package.
Production must match the filer's selected official language and must not mix annual English and French form revisions.
